sv.title: Dödliga attacker i Gaza – samtidigt varnas för epidemi
sv.summary: Minst nio palestinier har dödats i israeliska attacker i Gaza sedan i natt, bland dem Hamasstyrets biträdande utbildningsminister och hans fru. Den senaste veckan har flera attacker riktats mot personer inom Hamasstyrets civila förvaltning och även krävt andra civila liv.

en.title: Deadly Attacks in Gaza – Epidemic Warning Issued at the Same Time
en.summary: At least nine Palestinians have been killed in Israeli attacks in Gaza since last night, among them the deputy education minister of the Hamas government and his wife. Over the past week, several attacks have targeted people within the Hamas government's civil administration and have also killed other civilians.
